issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: iFixAi
products.tagline: Independent auditing of AI agents to uncover misalignment
products.summaryZh: 对AI代理进行独立审计，以揭示其行为偏差
products.descriptionZh: iFixAi是一家独立审计机构，帮助企业评估其AI代理是否可信。与仅依赖评估和可观测性工具不同，其多方位审计涵盖69类AI失准问题下的250项检查，融合AI红队测试、运营保障以及哲学、伦理和社会学视角。它能识别测试中的故障，解释其业务影响，并提供工程师可用于调查和修复的证据。
products.description: iFixAi is an independent auditor helping companies assess whether they can trust their AI agents. Unlike relying solely on evals and observability tools, its multifaceted audit includes 250 inspections across 69 categories of AI misalignment, combining AI red teaming, operational assurance, and philosophical, ethical, and sociological perspectives. It identifies failures under testing, explains their business implications, and provides evidence engineers can use to investigate and fix them.

products.name: LUCI Desktop
products.tagline: Let your AI agents remember what you've seen
products.summaryZh: 让你的 AI 智能体记住你看到过什么
products.descriptionZh: Luci 将你的屏幕历史和会议记录保存在本地，因此 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 等智能体可以帮你找到忘记收藏的页面，或回忆起通话中的某个决定。无需为每个应用单独设置连接器，即可跨应用捕获上下文。内置设备端转录功能，并借助 Microsoft Foundry Local 生成每日摘要。Mac 和 Windows 版免费。
products.description: Luci saves your screen history and meeting transcripts locally, so agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can help you find a page you forgot to bookmark or recall a decision from a call. Capture context across apps without setting up a connector for each one. Includes on-device transcription and daily summaries with Microsoft Foundry Local. Free for Mac and Windows.

products.name: ZenABM
products.tagline: Create, optimize & report on LinkedIn Ads from any AI tool
products.summaryZh: 从任何AI工具创建、优化和报告LinkedIn广告
products.descriptionZh: 告别复制粘贴到 Campaign Manager 的时代！通过 ZenABM 的 MCP 服务器，或直接使用我们的 AI Agent Zena，在你常用的 AI 工具（Claude、ChatGPT、Perplexity 等）中创建、启动并优化 LinkedIn 广告活动——两者均配备 20+ 专家技能和 96 个工具！+ 用我们的 AI Agents Zena 生成的每周和每月报告，自动化你的报告流程（包括公司互动和收入归因）。
products.description: Ditch copy-pasting into Campaign Manager! Create, launch & optimize your LinkedIn Ad Campaigns from your favourite AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) with ZenABM’s MCP server or natively with our AI Agent Zena - both equipped with 20+ expert skills and 96 tools! +Automate your reporting (including company engagements & revenue attribution) with weekly & monthly reports produced by our AI Agents Zena.

products.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
products.tagline: Anthropic's second model in the Claude 5.5 family
products.summaryZh: Anthropic的Claude 5.5系列第二款模型
products.descriptionZh: Claude Sonnet 5.5 是 Anthropic 推出的快速、高性价比 AI 模型，适用于日常工作：编码、修复 bug、文档、幻灯片和设计。它比 Sonnet 5 快 30% 以上，任务成本最多降低 30%，并在编码和知识工作方面提供更强的性能。
products.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is Anthropic’s fast, cost-efficient AI model for everyday work: coding, bug fixes, documents, slides, and design. It runs 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5, lowers task costs up to 30%, and delivers stronger coding and knowledge-work performance.

products.name: Semos.ai Manager Agents
products.tagline: AI agents purpose-built for managers
products.summaryZh: 专为管理者打造的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: 管理代理会从你的会议中学习，然后指引你关注接下来需要留意的事项：逾期未给的反馈、你忽略的认可、你回避的冲突、一再拖延的成长对话。你会了解哪些做法有效、哪些无效以及原因，从而更善于领导你的团队。
products.description: Manager Agents learn from your meetings, then point you to what needs your attention next: the feedback that is overdue, the recognition you missed, the conflict you are avoiding, the growth talk that keeps slipping. You learn what works, what doesn't, and why, so you become better at leading your people.

products.name: Paste 7
products.tagline: Intelligent clipboard that knows what you're about to paste
products.summaryZh: 智能剪贴板，预知你即将粘贴的内容
products.descriptionZh: 智能剪贴板是 Paste 的新功能，这款效率应用会记住你复制的所有内容。Paste 现在会根据你正在处理的工作，预测你最可能接下来粘贴哪条已复制内容。由 Apple Intelligence 驱动，在你的 Mac 上私密运行。
products.description: Intelligent Clipboard is new in Paste, the productivity app that remembers everything you copy. Paste now suggests which of your copied items you'll most likely paste next, based on what you're working on. Powered by Apple Intelligence, privately on your Mac.

products.name: Hopscotch AI
products.tagline: 500+ AI models available via a single API
products.summaryZh: 通过单一API即可使用500多种AI模型
products.descriptionZh: 🎁 Product Hunt 独家福利：前 250 名注册的 PH 用户可获得 50 美元免费模型额度。创建免费账户，并在 Billing 标签页中兑换代码 HOPSCOTCH50OFF。 | 🚀 通过一个 API 访问来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等的 500 多个 AI 模型。无需管理单独的集成、账户或付款，即可使用多个提供商。针对你的提示词比较模型、配置回退方案，并在一处跟踪用量和支出。按提供商费率付费，无平台费用或 token 加价。
products.description: 🎁 PRODUCT HUNT EXCLUSIVE: The first 250 PH users to sign up get $50 in free model credits. Create your free account and redeem code HOPSCOTCH50OFF in the Billing tab. | 🚀 Access 500+ AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more through one API. Use multiple providers without managing separate integrations, accounts, or payments. Compare models on your prompts, configure fallbacks, and track usage and spend in one place. Pay provider rates with no platform fees or token markup.

products.name: Would you pay?
products.tagline: Find out who'd pay before you build more
products.summaryZh: 在扩大建设之前，先弄清楚谁会买单。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数副业项目都悄无声息地失败了：开发数月，却无人付费。Would you pay? 把你的创业项目展示给真实用户，他们只有在愿意付费时才会向右滑动。你能看到愿意付费的用户比例、他们是谁，以及谁点击了链接。免费。
products.description: Most side projects fail quietly: months of building, then nobody pays. Would you pay? shows your startup to real people who swipe right only if they'd pay for it. You see the % who'd pay, who they are, and who clicked through. Free.

products.name: Timeless Code
products.tagline: Meeting notetaker that installs and runs inside Claude Code
products.summaryZh: 在 Claude Code 中安装并运行的会议记录工具
products.descriptionZh: 一个内置于 Claude Code 的 AI 笔记工具。Claude 会为你完成设置，此后你便可在终端中录制会议，并就任何提及的内容进行提问。
products.description: An AI notetaker that lives inside Claude Code. Claude sets it up for you, and from then on you can record meetings and ask about anything that was said, right from your terminal.

products.name: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude
products.tagline: Create, send, and sign documents in ChatGPT and Claude
products.summaryZh: 在ChatGPT和Claude中创建、发送和签署文档
products.descriptionZh: Jotform Sign 现已支持 ChatGPT 和 Claude，将文档创建与电子签名直接引入你的 AI 工作空间。通过提示词或上传文件即可创建可签名文档，编辑内容与签名字段，管理收件人和签署顺序，发送文档以供签署，并跟踪进度，全程无需切换工具。现有 Jotform Sign 用户也可直接在 ChatGPT 或 Claude 中访问和管理其工作流。
products.description: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude brings document creation and e-signatures directly into your AI workspace. Create signature-ready documents from a prompt or uploaded file, edit content and signing fields, manage recipients and signing order, send documents for signature, and track their progress without switching tools. Existing Jotform Sign users can also access and manage their workflows right from ChatGPT or Claude.

products.name: Curie
products.tagline: Assistant for scientific literature and document analysis.
products.summaryZh: 科学文献与文档分析助手。
products.descriptionZh: Curie 是一款为真实科研工作打造的 AI 研究助手，而非通用聊天机器人。它并行检索 PubMed、arXiv、Europe PMC、OpenAlex 和 Semantic Scholar，再对照原文核验每一项论断，让你看清哪些有依据、哪些没有。将文档交给它，即可提取结构化数据，并附上每个数值对应的原文引文；也可运行完整的系统综述，涵盖方案、筛选、PRISMA 流程图，每一步决策都由你确认。项目和资料库让一切井然有序。
products.description: Curie is an AI research assistant built for real scientific work, not a generalist chatbot. It searches PubMed, arXiv, Europe PMC, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar in parallel, then verifies every claim against the source text, so you see what's backed and what isn't. Point it at a document to extract structured data with the quote behind each value, or run a full systematic review, protocol, screening, PRISMA diagram, with you approving every decision. Projects and a library keep it organized.

products.name: Arsaze
products.tagline: Let Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini edit your real timeline
products.summaryZh: 让 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Gemini 编辑你的真实时间线
products.descriptionZh: Arsaze 是面向智能体和人类的 AI 视频编辑器——可以理解为视频编辑领域的 Cursor。一条真正的多轨时间线，你和 AI 智能体都能通过 MCP 或对话来驱动它，在一条真实的时间线上实现 AI 视频编辑、AI 视频生成和智能体驱动的视频编辑。
products.description: Arsaze is the AI video editor for agents and humans — think Cursor for video editing. A real multi-track timeline that both you and an AI agent can drive over MCP or by talking to it, for AI video editing, AI video generation, and agent-driven video editing on one real timeline.

products.name: Imejis.io
products.tagline: Give your agent a design studio to automate your marketing
products.summaryZh: 给你的代理一个设计工作室，自动化你的营销
products.descriptionZh: 你的 AI agent 写文案，Imejis 连图片一起交付。通过 MCP 为 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 等 AI agent 提供一个设计工作室。创建、编辑、预览并渲染可直接用于生产的图形。制作 OG 图片、社交卡片、营销图形、图表、证书、二维码等。设计一次，规模化生成。与生成式图像模型不同，Imejis 是确定性的：相同的输入产生相同的像素，保持你的品牌、布局、排版和数据一致。免费开始
products.description: Your AI agent writes the copy. With Imejis, it ships the image too. Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI agents a design studio via MCP. Create, edit, preview, and render production-ready graphics. Build OG images, social cards, marketing graphics, charts, certificates, QR codes and more. Design once. Generate at scale. Unlike generative image models, Imejis is deterministic: the same input produces the same pixels, keeping your brand, layout, typography, and data consistent. Free to start

products.name: Gladys Assistant 5
products.tagline: Private, self-hosted smart home, no YAML required
products.summaryZh: 私有、自托管的智能家居，无需YAML
products.descriptionZh: Gladys Assistant 是一个免费、开源的智能家居平台，运行在你自己的迷你电脑或树莓派上。支持 Zigbee、Z-Wave、Matter 以及 90 多个社区集成，以手机优先的仪表盘，无需 YAML，即使断网也能持续工作。
products.description: Gladys Assistant is a free, open-source smart home platform that runs on your own mini-PC or Raspberry Pi. Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter and 90+ community integrations, a phone-first dashboard, no YAML, and it keeps working when the internet goes down.

products.name: Declutr
products.tagline: Tidy your Mac's desktop and downloads in one click
products.summaryZh: 一键整理Mac桌面和下载文件夹
products.descriptionZh: Declutr 一键将你的桌面、下载或任意文件夹按文件类型整理到对应文件夹：图片、文档、视频、归档、代码、3D 模型等。一次撤销即可将所有文件还原。自首次发布以来的新变化：已上架 Mac App Store，支持智能规则（名称、扩展名、时间、大小）、监控文件夹（新文件一落地即整理）以及每日清理。基于规则，而非 AI：它从不读取文件内容。整理免费，Pro 版一次性付费 $8.99。
products.description: Declutr sorts your Desktop, Downloads or any folder into folders by file type in one click: Images, Documents, Videos, Archives, Code, 3D Models and more. One Undo puts every file back. New since the first launch: it's on the Mac App Store, with Smart Rules (name, extension, age, size), watched folders that sort new files as they land, and a daily cleanup. Rules, not AI: it never reads what's inside your files. Free to sort, Pro is $8.99 once.

products.name: Supertake
products.tagline: AI that turn your ideas into real investments
products.summaryZh: 将想法转化为真实投资的人工智能
products.descriptionZh: Supertake利用前沿AI和交易代理，将你对世界的独特见解转化为真实、可分享的投资组合。迄今为止，我们的投资一直受制于财务经理、ETF以及由骗子和算法推广的个股。但有了Supertake，你只需用自然语言告诉代理你所相信的，它就能创建一个神奇的投资组合，并代表你进行交易。Supertake可与Robinhood和Coinbase等现有券商合作。
products.description: Supertake transforms your unique takes on the world into real, shareable investment portfolios using frontier AI and trading agents. Until now, we’ve invested at the mercy of financial managers, ETFs, and single stocks promoted by grifters and algorithms. But with Supertake you simply tell the agent what you believe in natural language and it creates a magical portfolio of assets and places the trades on your behalf. Supertake works with existing brokerages like Robinhood and Coinbase.

products.name: Clink
products.tagline: The iOS keyboard you actually own
products.summaryZh: 你真正拥有的iOS键盘
products.descriptionZh: Clink 是一款可定制的 iOS 键盘，也是独立应用和品牌栖身之所。主题、布局和工具由你掌控，还有合作伙伴将他们的品牌融入你每天用来打字的工具中。注重隐私，即将登陆 Android！
products.description: Clink is a custom iOS keyboard and a place for indie apps and brands to live on it. Themes, layouts and tools you control, plus partners who put their brand in the thing you type with all day. Privacy focused and headed to Android soon!

products.name: ShipHappens:
products.tagline: ASO, keywords & screenshots for the app store
products.summaryZh: 应用商店的ASO、关键词与截图
products.descriptionZh: App Store Connect 又慢又笨重，还把真正能带来下载量的东西都藏了起来。ShipHappens 是我为此打造的 Mac 原生应用。用 Apple 自己的搜索热度数据挑选关键词，用 AI 制作截图，一次性把商品页翻译成 39 种语言，对产品页做 A/B 测试，用任意语言回复评论。一个覆盖你所有应用的动态流会告诉你接下来该修什么。你的密钥保存在 Keychain 里，你可以接入任意 AI 服务商，也可以运行本地模型。
products.description: App Store Connect is slow, clunky, and buries everything that actually gets you downloads. ShipHappens is the native Mac app I built to fix that. Pick keywords using Apple's own search popularity data, make screenshots with AI, translate your listing into 39 languages in one go, A/B test your product page, and reply to reviews in any language. A feed across all your apps tells you what to fix next. Your key stays in your Keychain, and you can bring any AI provider or run a local model.

products.name: Pokébinder
products.tagline: Plan your Pokémon binder, then print what's missing
products.summaryZh: 规划你的宝可梦卡册，然后打印缺少的部分
products.descriptionZh: 一款面向宝可梦集换式卡牌收藏者的免费卡册规划工具。可搜索 40,000 多张英文和日文卡牌，编排 3×3 页面，将自定义图案铺满整页并让卡牌置于其上，然后为尚未拥有的卡牌打印实际尺寸的占位卡。无需账户——你的卡册保存在浏览器中。
products.description: A free binder planner for Pokémon TCG collectors. Search 40,000+ English and Japanese cards, arrange 3×3 pages, run your own art behind a whole page with cards on top, then print true-size placeholders for the cards you don't own yet. No account — your binder stays in your browser.

products.name: Engine Room Media
products.tagline: We Run The Numbers. You Run The Show.
products.summaryZh: 我们精算数据，你掌控全局。
products.descriptionZh: Engine Room 为创作者成长而打造，将你所有平台的分析数据、媒体资料包和报价卡整合到一个易于使用的仪表盘中。Engine Room Media 通过数据驱动的洞察、品牌合作和同行联系，帮助创作者在包括 YouTube、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、Patreon、Spotify 和 Twitch 在内的所有常用平台上成长。
products.description: Built for Creator growth, Engine Room brings all of your platform analytics, media kit, and rate cards together in one easy to use dashboard. Engine Room Media helps creators grow across all their favorite platforms (including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Patreon, Spotify, and Twitch) with data-driven insights, brand deals, and peer connections.
